description: X1 Agent Passport: an ERC-8004 identity for your agent in the X1 Agent Registry (the Solana Agent Registry, deployed on X1 by APEX), done for you in one paid call. Returns the live price in XNT, where to pay, and the exact request. Pay the XNT to payTo from the wallet that should own the agent, then POST your {name, description, services?} to the route with the transfer signature in the X-PAYMENT header: we register the agent and hand its NFT to the paying wallet. Or register yourself for network fees only (see page).
name: x1_passport
